purpose: The Emotion Track's ten tags, their standard facial cues, and the per-emotion contradicting-word lists. The picture and H3 prompt builders read a beat row's emotion, intensity and cues from here and write them into the prompt; the dispatcher refuses a prompt for a shot with a person when the expression is missing (EXPRESSION_MISSING) or carries a word from that emotion's contradicting list (EXPRESSION_CONTRADICTS). One list per emotion, one home: never fork these words into a builder.

pain.cues: Eyes glassy or shut; brows drawn up and together; mouth pressed or trembling; tears at intensity 3.

worry.cues: Eyes searching; brows knit; lips pressed.

exhaustion.cues: Heavy lids; slack brows; mouth slightly open; shoulders low.

anger.cues: Hard eyes; brows down; jaw set.

hope.cues: Eyes lifting; brows soft; corners of the mouth just rising.

relief.cues: Eyes closing then opening; brows released; a breath out.

resolve.cues: Level eyes; brows set; mouth firm.

one_step_stronger.rule: For a lip-sync picture (no prompt reaches the model), draw these one step stronger than the tag: mouth corners clearly down, brows drawn, no teeth. The model drifts toward the music, so it starts further from the grin (section 3G.6 lever 2).

expression_sheet_map.anger: angry (made on demand: no fixed sheet carries it)

refusals.EMOTION_MISSING: a beat-sheet row without all three columns
refusals.EXPRESSION_MISSING: a prompt for a shot with a person in it that carries no expression
refusals.EXPRESSION_CONTRADICTS: a prompt carrying a word from the emotion's contradicting list

note: A lip-sync job carries no prompt at all (N-08, S-42): the expression lives in the picture alone. Only the picture and H3 builders write these words.
